config.primary_gate: At the unchanged key-entry close, the 15m MTF module must emit a same-direction entry, with the latest confirmed H1 arrow strictly earlier. Same-close H1 refresh blocks entry, including repeated same-direction H1 arrows.
config.secondary_audit: Also record whether the original paired 15m arrow had been MTF-qualified; this is not the primary simultaneous-entry gate and does not defer or relocate entries.
config.management: First reuse all18 original exit ledgers with exact touch-wick stops. Separately run the screenshot management: latest5 completed5m extrema plus0.05percent entry buffer,15m close5R arms ATR14x4; armed H1 opposite exit retained, no breakeven or90minute cap.
config.controls: Reuse each original same-coin/side/week/half/volatility matched random time. For changed screenshot stops, copy the signal relative initial risk to its paired control, outward rounded to tick. Do not claim random candles themselves satisfy the MTF gate.
config.inference: Two primary gate associations under original pivot exits, week-cluster score with side/half/log-risk controls and Holm2. Alternate exits and periods are stability diagnostics, not independent validation or a search.

limitations: Historical selected cohort; same entry times. Shared15m oscillator means modules are dependent. Controls are conditional paired backgrounds, not MTF-constrained candles. Exact tick stops and frozen20bp costs; no funding/slippage/account compounding. Final boundary marks are not natural exits. No Pine/default change.
